categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Xuerong Biotechnology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, factory-based cultivation, and sales of fresh edible mushrooms. Its main products include enoki mushrooms, shimeji mushrooms (including crab-flavored, white jade, and seafood mushrooms), king oyster mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, and deer antler mushrooms. The company operates through multiple production bases domestically and internationally, focusing on modern agricultural facility-based mushroom production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs modern biotechnologies and industrialized factory cultivation methods for edible mushrooms. This includes controlled environment agriculture with temperature, humidity, airflow, and light regulation, mechanized and automated production processes, and standardized cultivation techniques. It also invests in proprietary strain development and hybrid breeding, holding multiple patents and plant variety rights to maintain technological leadership.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves distributors, supermarket chains, chain restaurants, and fresh food delivery platforms, mainly within the fresh edible mushroom market. Its products are sold primarily in China, with a growing presence in international markets including Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam. The customer base includes retail and foodservice sectors, with sales largely conducted through buyout agreements with distributors and direct sales to large retail chains.
categories.geographic_coverage: Shanghai Xuerong Biotechnology operates extensively across China with production bases in Jilin, Shandong, Guangdong, Sichuan, Guizhou, Gansu, Guangxi, and Jiangsu provinces. It also has an international production base in Thailand and sales operations in Malaysia and Vietnam. The company’s sales are predominantly in mainland China, accounting for approximately 88% of revenue, with the remainder from other countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the edible mushroom supply chain. It controls the production (factory cultivation) of mushroom products and their direct sales to distributors and retail customers. It sources raw materials such as agricultural by-products for cultivation but does not engage in upstream raw material production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on strengthening its core mushroom varieties, especially enoki and seafood mushrooms, ensuring stable production and quality. It emphasizes cost reduction through optimized procurement, improved production formulas, and energy efficiency. R&D efforts concentrate on strain purification, hybrid breeding, and cultivation formula optimization to enhance yield and product quality. The company also plans to expand financing channels and ensure smooth ownership transition.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of fresh edible mushrooms via distributors and direct sales to supermarkets and foodservice chains. The sales model is mainly buyout-based, with pricing and settlement managed through regional sales teams and marketing centers. Other minor revenue streams include sales of cultivation substrates, materials, and leasing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Xuerong Biotechnology is the largest factory-based edible mushroom producer in China, holding the top national position in enoki mushroom daily production capacity. It is recognized as a national key leading enterprise in agricultural industrialization and has a broad national production and sales network. The company competes in a highly fragmented and competitive mushroom industry facing overcapacity and price pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.16 billion, a 15.7% decline year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 617 million. The company has experienced a challenging market environment with declining prices and profitability. Total assets stood at about RMB 3.85 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 939 million. The company is in a contraction and stabilization phase, focusing on internal efficiency and cost control.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes food safety, high product quality, and stable supply through its modern factory cultivation methods. Its nationwide production layout ensures fresh product delivery close to consumption markets, enhancing freshness and reducing logistics costs. Proprietary strains and patented cultivation technologies provide competitive advantages in product quality and yield. The company also highlights its brand reputation, technological leadership, and commitment to sustainable agricultural practices.
